atri_2024_truckload_peer_group.source: ATRI Sample Carrier Operational Costs Report, 2025
atri_2024_truckload_peer_group.caveat: Freight tractor-trailer cohort, not household-goods box trucks; do not use as a production coefficient.

michelin_lifecycle_method.formula: (new tire price + retread/repair/mounting costs - casing residual value) / total achieved mileage over all casing lives
michelin_lifecycle_method.source: Michelin Truck Tire Service Manual (2023), Cost Analysis
michelin_lifecycle_method.caveat: Illustrative long-haul tire examples, not validated Class 6-7 household-moving truck tire prices or lifetimes. Michelin's method explicitly says wheel position and casing life matter.

tires.model_decision: Use ATRI only as an external comparator. For a defensible box-truck tire cost, recover VIUS tire-size/axle configuration where available and obtain actual replacement/retread mileage and invoices from a mover or fleet dataset. VIUS has rear-axle tire count but no tire expense.

icct_class_6_7_straight_truck_purchase_p.source: ICCT Working Paper 2023-10, Table A2: Class 6-7 straight truck price evolution
icct_class_6_7_straight_truck_purchase_p.caveat: Forecast/modelled diesel straight-truck purchase-price benchmark in 2022 dollars, published 2023; not a current dealer transaction, not a verified household-goods box-body complete-vehicle price, and not a residual-value series.

atri_truckload_peer_group.source: ATRI Sample Carrier Operational Costs Report, 2025
atri_truckload_peer_group.caveat: Truck and trailer payment cost for freight truckload peer group; not pure depreciation and not moving-box-truck specific.

market_context.source: NADA Annual Financial Profile / Wards Intelligence data
market_context.caveat: Sales volume only; this source's average selling price series is for Class 8, not Class 6-7. Do not mislabel the Class 8 price as Class 6-7.

capital.required_for_depreciation: Economic depreciation per mile requires purchase price of the actual truck/body configuration, expected holding period or lifetime miles, residual/disposal value, financing/cost of capital, and annual utilization. None of the cited sources supplies all of these for household-goods Class 6-7 box trucks.
capital.model_decision: Keep depreciation unresolved. Do not turn the ICCT purchase forecast or ATRI lease/purchase cost into a depreciation coefficient. Obtain matched acquisition and resale data or mover fleet records, then calculate (purchase price + capital cost - residual value) / lifetime operating miles.

guardrails: All entries are research comparators, not production coefficients.
Do not add tire per-mile benchmarks to maintenance if the source's maintenance line already excludes or includes tire costs differently; preserve definitions.
Do not mix equipment payment, depreciation, financing interest, and cost of capital without a consistent accounting boundary.
No application formula, coefficient, displayed price or route distance changed.
